Wastewater discharge in Exampleton reaches Sample River

Tuesday, August 4, 2026
News Release
Image

EXAMPLETON -- The Iowa Department of Natural Resources has been contacted regarding a wastewater discharge into the Sample River in Example County.

On Saturday, July 25th around 2:00 pm, the Exampleton wastewater treatment plant began bypassing partially treated wastewater directly to the Sample River. On July 26, the DNR Field Office was notified by the City of Exampleton. The bypass was routed past 4321 Example Ave.

An estimated 1.5 million gallons was released over the duration of the event, which ended July 27th around 4 p.m.

Downstream recreational users should take caution and avoid the area at this time.

To report a release after hours, please call the DNR's emergency spill line at (555) 555-0199.
